en: Historic black‑and‑white postcard view of a European spa town with a narrow river or canal running through the middle, tree‑lined promenades on both banks, and multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century fashion stroll along the promenade while horse‑drawn carriages move along the street. A small pedestrian bridge crosses the water. Shop signs and awnings are visible on the right‑hand side, including a restaurant.
